classification: test-gate; no production or image change
gap: The ten composed subcases do not inject an invalid referenced backup block. Normal restores and target/credential refusal do not prove broken-chain handling. Matrix remains pending.
product_entry: Existing config.yml + kubecli setup 09 source/backup workflow followed by official native restore CR negative probe and normal CSI independent recovery. No Helm bypass.
conclusions: V2 instance-manager proxies EngineBackupRestore to SPDK, whose Replica.backupRestore calls backupstore.RestoreDeltaBlockBackup. Restore reads, decompresses and verifies every referenced block; source backup metadata presence alone is insufficient.

Missing block reads retry at 1,5,30,60,120,300 seconds (516 seconds plus IO). An engine-level missing-key failure must be observed with exact requested backup, failed volume UID and referenced key. Timeout by itself is not refusal evidence.

Error state prevents restarting the same failed SPDK restoration. Retire the precisely owned failed restore target through native deletion, repair the original block from verified escrow, then use a new CSI target for successful recovery; do not edit status or force finalizers.

Only a runner-created isolated bucket and an exact cfg-referenced block are eligible. Journal intent before changes, verify original and escrow byte hashes, handle lost copy/delete responses by readback, never overwrite a different original or delete unknown objects. On ambiguity retain journal and stop downstream store cleanup.

The gate must preserve first failure and restore its own fault before normal business/store cleanup on success, failure or interruption. It must verify new recovery data/time boundary/write isolation and source cross-node integrity.
boundary: Design/source evidence only. Helper, focused contracts and live qualification not yet implemented or run; not complete matrix or delivery acceptance.
